description: mongoose's classification against the conformance corpus (conformance/actions.json). 'adapterUnsupported' lists 'conformance' actions this adapter cannot express, each with the reason (naming the real mechanism) and the substring its thrown error must contain. 'adapterSupportedExpected' lists 'expectedUnsupported' actions this adapter deliberately translates, so they are oracle-compared instead of thrown. 'expectedUnsupportedMessages' pins the throw message for every 'expectedUnsupported' action it does not promote, and 'nullRepresentationOmittedMessages' for every 'nullRepresentationOmitted' action. validate-corpus.sh checks all four against the corpus; the harness refuses to run with a message missing.

adapterUnsupported.reason: a CONSTANT is what tells CEL's two `+` overloads apart, and between two field paths there is none. MongoDB spells the two differently — $add accepts numeric and date types only, $concat strings — and the mapper carries no field types, so neither can be chosen. Sending $add anyway is what the server aborts the whole query on, so the shape is refused at translation instead
